description: This file implements functions for handling IPv4 and IPv6 address operations, including conversions, comparisons, and interface address retrieval, within a network device context.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_get_family
methods.description: Determines the address family (IPv4 or IPv6) of a given nu_ipaddr_t address.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_to_inaddr
methods.description: Converts a nu_ipaddr_t to an IPv4 in_addr structure if possible.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_to_in6addr
methods.description: Converts a nu_ipaddr_t to an IPv6 in6_addr structure if possible.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_to_sockaddr
methods.description: Converts a nu_ipaddr_t to a sockaddr structure with specified port.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_to_str
methods.description: Converts a nu_ipaddr_t to its string IP address representation.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_str
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a nu_ipaddr_t, or 'UNKNOWN' if conversion fails.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_from_str
methods.description: Parses a string IP address into a nu_ipaddr_t structure.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_from_sockaddr_storage
methods.description: Converts a sockaddr_storage to a nu_ipaddr_t, extracting address and port.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_from_inaddr
methods.description: Converts an IPv4 in_addr to a nu_ipaddr_t.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_from_in6addr
methods.description: Converts an IPv6 in6_addr to a nu_ipaddr_t.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_equal
methods.description: Checks if two nu_ipaddr_t addresses are equal.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_copy
methods.description: Copies one nu_ipaddr_t to another.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_set_zero
methods.description: Sets a nu_ipaddr_t to the zero address.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_is_zero
methods.description: Checks if a nu_ipaddr_t is the zero address.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_get_interface_addr_from_dest_addr
methods.description: Determines the source IP address of the interface used to send a packet to a destination address.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_get_interface_addr_from_sock_fd
methods.description: Gets the interface IP address from a connected socket.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_get_interface_name_from_src_addr
methods.description: Finds the interface name given its source IP address.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_has_interface_addr_changed
methods.description: Checks if the IP address of a network interface has changed from an expected address.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_get_ip_supported_families
methods.description: Detects whether IPv4 and/or IPv6 addresses are supported on the device.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_is_valid_interface
methods.description: Verifies if a given interface name exists on the device.
